output.body: Take the isomorph sum_to(n), which adds all whole numbers from 1 up to n: the base case is sum_to(1) = 1, and for n > 1 the problem becomes n plus sum_to(n-1), because the rest is the same problem one size smaller. Tracing sum_to(3) gives 3 plus sum_to(2), which needs 2 plus sum_to(1), and sum_to(1) returns 1 directly, so the pending additions unwind to 6. Without a base case the calls would never stop, so every recursive function needs both a stopping case and a self-call on a smaller input.
